subject: Corven raven
verdict: accepted as a convincing stylized raven and polished five-performance workbench study

brief.physicalInterpretation: living raven expressed through charcoal and indigo sculptural planes
brief.gesture: watchful forward bill, quiet lifted breast, long wedge tail, wings held in reserve
brief.identity: heavy tapered bill, fitted dark eye, throat hackles, wedge tail, two four-toed feet and articulated flight-feather hierarchy
brief.surface: continuous breast and nape; restrained sheen on flight vanes and keratin

views.judgment: Heavy bill, continuous crown-to-breast gesture, reverse hocks and wedge tail read without pigment. Folded wings remain compact; breast is not a feather-tile pile.
Charcoal body, indigo vanes and black bill retain raven identity at consumer size. Phone controls wrap without horizontal overflow.
Elevated views show overlapping secondaries as a continuous trailing plane and distinct primary tips. The shoulder plane meets the body; elbow and wrist are readable through unfolding.
Saved neck-weight repair keeps the skull and bill together while turning toward the shoulder. Both feet remain planted; the continuous breast is retained.

idle.review: Actual 1x and decoded frames: restrained breath and small alert head response, stable planted feet, seamless repeated rest.

walk.review: Actual 1x and 12 fps decoded frames: alternating foot recoveries, deliberate small steps and restrained body transfer. Repeated cycles close. Separate scene-travel journey covers a single 0.4091-unit stride.

look.review: Actual 1x: turn, readable listening hold, smaller answering glance and recovery. The bill leads without dragging the feet.

spread.review: Actual 1x from an orbited elevated consumer view plus 4 fps decoding: shoulder opens first, then forearm/wrist and feather fans. Short display hold, staged fold and a stable finish. Saved left response is delayed 0.07 seconds.

preen.review: Actual 1x plus 3 fps decoding: gradual shoulder reach, small nibbling checks, controlled return and final hold. Grounded pose remains legible.

repairs: Replaced naive world-Euler wing folding with armature-space target axes converted to each joint rest space.
Added secondary-root sweep joints and independent primary-root folding so the open fan can close without lifting a rigid feather comb above the back.
Widened secondary overlap and separated primary tips after elevated clay exposed a merged pointed wing.
Repaired saved neck weights to carry the cheek with the head through preening.
Reduced wing mantle thickness, removed noisy raised covert tiles and fitted restrained scapular planes in the saved character.
Rejected and reverted a late scapular expansion that made hollow shoulder loops in rear clay.
Resampled saved spread control keys by joint group and updated the open marker; contacts and trajectory are stationary and unchanged.

limits: Owner self-review only, not independent or user approval.
Broad stylized feather plates and simplified flat-foot stepping; no individual toe roll, feather collision, feather simulation or aerodynamic model.
No captured animal motion or synchronized reference comparison. Reference fidelity and calibrated biomechanics remain unassessed.
Flight, takeoff and landing are outside this grounded five-clip scope.
